```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(".", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"), local = TRUE)
SensitivityRead <- function(path) {
  utils::read.csv(
    path,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    na.strings = ""
  )
}
SensitivitySteel <- SensitivityRead(Calculation$paths$sensitivitySteelExtrema)
SensitivityAashto <- SensitivityRead(Calculation$paths$sensitivityAashtoChecks)
SensitivityPlain <- SensitivityRead(Calculation$paths$sensitivityPlainChecks)
SensitivitySweep <- SensitivityRead(Calculation$paths$sensitivityPmSweep)
SensitivityModuli <- sort(unique(SensitivitySteel$modulusMPa))
if (length(SensitivityModuli) < 2L) {
  stop("The sensitivity products require at least two moduli.")
}
SensitivityFirst <- SensitivityModuli[1L]
SensitivityLast <- SensitivityModuli[length(SensitivityModuli)]
SensitivityList <- function(values) {
  Values <- as.character(values)
  if (length(Values) == 1L) return(Values)
  paste(
    paste(head(Values, -1L), collapse = ", "),
    tail(Values, 1L),
    sep = " y "
  )
}
SensitivitySteelValue <- function(caseID, resultantID, modulus) {
  Value <- SensitivitySteel$value[
    SensitivitySteel$caseID == caseID &
      SensitivitySteel$resultantID == resultantID &
      SensitivitySteel$modulusMPa == modulus
  ]
  if (length(Value) != 1L || !is.finite(Value)) {
    stop("Missing steel sensitivity value: ", caseID, ".", resultantID)
  }
  Value
}
SensitivitySteelReductionPct <- function(caseID, resultantID) {
  100 * (1 -
    SensitivitySteelValue(caseID, resultantID, SensitivityLast) /
      SensitivitySteelValue(caseID, resultantID, SensitivityFirst))
}
SensitivityAashtoRanges <- tapply(
  SensitivityAashto$utilization,
  SensitivityAashto$checkID,
  function(x) diff(range(x))
)
SensitivityAashtoConstant <- all(SensitivityAashtoRanges < 1e-9)
SensitivitySeamU <- unique(formatCalculationFixed(
  SensitivityAashto$utilization[SensitivityAashto$checkID == "seam"],
  3L
))
SensitivityPlainU <- function(liningID, checkID, modulus) {
  Value <- SensitivityPlain$utilization[
    SensitivityPlain$liningID == liningID &
      SensitivityPlain$checkID == checkID &
      SensitivityPlain$modulusMPa == modulus
  ]
  if (length(Value) != 1L || !is.finite(Value)) {
    stop("Missing plain sensitivity value: ", liningID, ".", checkID)
  }
  Value
}
SensitivityPlainTensionRobust <- all(
  SensitivityPlain$utilization[
    SensitivityPlain$checkID == "tension-face"
  ] > 1
)
SensitivitySweep$configurationID <- ifelse(
  SensitivitySweep$reinforcementArrangementID == "symmetric-two-face",
  paste0("S", SensitivitySweep$barDiameterMm),
  paste0("A", SensitivitySweep$barDiameterMm)
)
SensitivityPmStatus <- function(liningID, configurationID, modulus) {
  Value <- SensitivitySweep$localPMStatus[
    SensitivitySweep$liningID == liningID &
      SensitivitySweep$configurationID == configurationID &
      SensitivitySweep$modulusMPa == modulus
  ]
  if (length(Value) != 1L) {
    stop("Missing P-M sensitivity status: ", liningID, ".", configurationID)
  }
  Value
}
SensitivityConfigIDs <- function(liningID) {
  AUX <- SensitivitySweep[
    SensitivitySweep$liningID == liningID &
      SensitivitySweep$modulusMPa == SensitivityFirst,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  AUX$configurationID[order(AUX$reinforcementCaseOrder)]
}
SensitivityFlips <- function(liningID) {
  IDs <- SensitivityConfigIDs(liningID)
  IDs[vapply(IDs, function(s) {
    SensitivityPmStatus(liningID, s, SensitivityFirst) !=
      SensitivityPmStatus(liningID, s, SensitivityLast)
  }, logical(1))]
}
SensitivityPassing <- function(liningID, modulus) {
  IDs <- SensitivityConfigIDs(liningID)
  IDs[vapply(IDs, function(s) {
    identical(SensitivityPmStatus(liningID, s, modulus), "satisfied")
  }, logical(1))]
}
SensitivityStatusSentence <- function(ids) {
  if (length(ids) == 0L) return("ninguna configuración")
  SensitivityList(ids)
}
SensitivityPassSentence <- function(liningID, modulus, object = FALSE) {
  IDs <- SensitivityPassing(liningID, modulus)
  Object <- if (object) " la flexocompresión " else " "
  if (length(IDs) == 0L) {
    return(paste0("ninguna configuración satisface", Object))
  }
  paste0(
    if (length(IDs) == 1L) "satisface" else "satisfacen",
    Object,
    SensitivityList(IDs)
  )
}
```

# Sensibilidad al módulo del terreno {#sec-calculation-sensitivity}

Este capítulo cuantifica el efecto del módulo de deformación del terreno
sobre las verificaciones de los tres revestimientos. El caso completo se
recalcula para $E_g$ igual a
`r SensitivityList(SensitivityModuli)` MPa, manteniendo fijas todas las
demás entradas del escenario adoptado; cada módulo utiliza el mismo motor y
el mismo camino de productos que el cuerpo de la memoria.

{{< include /_chapters/sensitivity.es.qmd >}}
